item.text: {"analysis_packet":{"certificate":"Reject terminal self-validation, anchor-derived local repair, retrospective evidence admission, and circular control of evidence and construction. Covenant: admit only the inline task, anchor contract, task constraints, hypothesis, loop structure, and constructor-visible online observations; treat scores, hidden traces, evaluator state, benchmark content, oracle decisions, external sources, and post hoc rationalization as inadmissible. Bind public obligations to interface legality, standard-library-only operation, online one-access visibility, capacity safety, unique currently cached integer-key evictions, no prohibited information or adaptation, and exactly one final policy. Preserve the unresolved tension between direct anchor visibility and anchor-path dependence, and between multi-objective optimization and withheld scores; the covenant cannot resolve these by prescribing implementation behavior.","witnesses":["Inline task and constraints establish the public interface, legality, online visibility, capacity, eviction, dependency, and single-artifact obligations.","The anchor contract requires preserving interface legality, capacity safety, and online-only visibility while withholding scores.","The hypothesis identifies terminal authority, circular self-validation, local repair, and late justification as inherited bottlenecks.","The loop structure assigns this authority only preconstruction evidence admission and assigns materialization exclusively downstream."],"obligations":["Commit admissible evidence before any candidate artifact exists.","Expose the covenant as binding to the downstream constructor without granting this role policy-construction authority.","Reject hidden traces, benchmark paths, oracle decisions, external libraries or services, evaluator implementations, scores, and retrospective evidence.","Require public contract compliance and one final artifact while leaving implementation choices to the downstream constructor."],"exact_actions":["Enumerate the rejected inherited assumptions.","Fix the admissible evidence boundary to the inline inputs and lawful online observations only.","Record the public obligations and unresolved tensions in one binding covenant.","Transfer the covenant unchanged to the downstream artifact-construction authority."]},"artifact_kind":"analysis_only"}
